fields.name: log-level
fields.description: The log level: debug, info, warn, error

fields.name: log-level-debug-expires-at
fields.description: The timestamp indicating when debug-level logging should expire

fields.name: session-store-maximum-size
fields.description: The maximum size of the local in-memory session store cache in bytes.

fields.name: otel-collector-endpoint
fields.description: The endpoint of the OpenTelemetry collector to send observability data to (used for both tracing and logging if specific endpoints are not provided)

fields.name: otel-collector-endpoint-tls-cert-path
fields.description: Path to a file containing a PEM-encoded certificate to use as a CA for TLS connections to the OpenTelemetry collector

fields.name: otel-collector-endpoint-tls-cert
fields.description: A PEM-encoded certificate to use as a CA for TLS connections to the OpenTelemetry collector

fields.name: otel-collector-endpoint-tls-insecure
fields.description: Allow insecure connections to the OpenTelemetry collector

fields.name: otel-tracing-disabled
fields.description: Disable OpenTelemetry tracing

fields.name: otel-logging-disabled
fields.description: Disable OpenTelemetry logging

fields.name: health-check
fields.description: Enable the HTTP health check endpoint

fields.name: health-check-port
fields.description: Port for the HTTP health check endpoint

fields.name: health-check-bind-address
fields.description: Bind address for health check server (127.0.0.1 for localhost-only)

fields.name: http-timeout-seconds
fields.description: HTTP client timeout in seconds (max 1800)

fields.name: kubeconfig
fields.description: Path to the kubeconfig file to use for CLI requests.

fields.name: client-certificate
fields.description: Path to a client certificate file for TLS

fields.name: client-key
fields.description: Path to a client key file for TLS

fields.name: token
fields.description: Bearer token for authentication to the API server

fields.name: as
fields.description: Username to impersonate for the operation. User could be a regular user or a service account in a namespace.

fields.name: as-uid
fields.description: UID to impersonate for the operation.

fields.name: as-group
fields.description: Group to impersonate for the operation, this flag can be repeated to specify multiple groups.

fields.name: cluster
fields.description: The name of the kubeconfig cluster to use

fields.name: user
fields.description: The name of the kubeconfig user to use

fields.name: context
fields.description: The name of the kubeconfig context to use

fields.name: server
fields.description: The address and port of the Kubernetes API server

fields.name: tls-server-name
fields.description: Server name to use for server certificate validation. If it is not provided, the hostname used to contact the server is used

fields.name: insecure-skip-tls-verify
fields.description: If true, the server's certificate will not be checked for validity. This will make your HTTPS connections insecure

fields.name: certificate-authority
fields.description: Path to a cert file for the certificate authority

fields.name: request-timeout
fields.description: The length of time to wait before giving up on a single server request. Non-zero values should contain a corresponding time unit (e.g. 1s, 2m, 3h). A value of zero means don't timeout requests.

fields.name: disable-compression
fields.description: If true, opt-out of response compression for all requests to the server

fields.name: use-role-assignments
fields.description: If true, sync each (cluster role, scope) pair that has a binding as a role assignment resource, instead of declaring one entitlement per cluster role per namespace. Namespaced roles are unaffected.
